note: Official questions mapped to FM Chapter 3 (Financial Analysis and Planning — Ratio Analysis). Primary code first. Chapter assignment for RTPs follows ICAI's own topic labels; for past papers and MTPs it follows the ratios the question is solved with. **Two atoms were added in the back-fill pass (04-10-2026)**: PYQ-J25-MCQ6 and MCQ7, the two parts of the VP Ltd. Case Scenario II in the January 2025 paper. They were missed because sources/coverage.py skips Part I, whose (a) to (d) are MCQ options rather than question sub-parts, so FM Part-I MCQs are a blind spot of that script. The same blind spot is recorded in BUILD_STATE.md. **Five more atoms were added in the same pass**: the whole of the Solstice Biotech Ltd. Part-I case scenario of MTP September 2026 Series 2 (FMCQ1 to FMCQ5), which runs a single set of three-year financial statements through the liquidity, turnover, capital-structure, coverage and profitability ratios and then asks a credit officer to interpret two of them together. It is the most complete ratio-analysis case in the official bank and is worth working as a unit. MCQs 6, 7 and 8 of the same Part I belong to FM Ch 7 and Ch 4 and are recorded on the back-fill list.
